ideas.title: Minnesota nonprofit organizations lack oversight, enabling fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the lack of oversight and management of nonprofit organizations in Minnesota, which may have enabled the $90 million fraud scheme involving Feeding Our Future.
ideas.angle: The lack of oversight and management of nonprofit organizations in Minnesota
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
How was the fraud able to occur?
What can be done to prevent similar fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota fraud scandal highlights the need for greater oversight and management of nonprofit organizations in the state. An investigation into the lack of oversight and management could uncover the root causes of the fraud and lead to recommendations for prevention in the future.
